schema.name: topic-news
schema.description: File each incoming news item under one of four broad sections.
schema.state: One news item as an object with a `text` field: the headline, optionally followed by its first paragraph.

state.text: Coastal states sign fisheries pact after three years of talks. Ministers from six countries agreed on shared quotas for the northern shelf, ending a dispute that had closed ports twice this year.
Rivers United clinch the title on the final day. A stoppage-time header gave the club its first league crown in 31 years as their closest rivals drew away from home.
Harbor Point Energy to cut 1,200 jobs as profits slide. The utility said third-quarter earnings fell 38 percent on lower wholesale power prices and higher borrowing costs.

Battery cell keeps 90% of its capacity after 5,000 charge cycles, researchers report. The team combined a silicon-carbon anode with a new electrolyte additive, according to a paper published this week.
Investor group buys basketball franchise for $2.1 billion. The sale, approved by the league's owners on Tuesday, is the second-highest price ever paid for a team.
Lawmakers approve rules forcing app stores to allow outside payment systems. The regulation takes effect next year and applies to platforms with more than 45 million monthly users.

# Tez schema (format: docs/API.md, "Schema files"). The four labels, their descriptions and the instruction are
# the ones used for the AG News measurement (experiments/bench_h2h.py); the state is an object with a `text` field.
name: topic-news
description: File each incoming news item under one of four broad sections.
state: "One news item as an object with a `text` field: the headline, optionally followed by its first paragraph."
questions:
  topic:
    type: choice
    instructions: What is the topic of `text`?
    criteria:
      World: world news, politics, international affairs
      Sports: sports
      Business: business, economy, finance
      Sci/Tech: science and technology
